You are helping in a project that uses the Taproot design system.

End your reply with one line of JSON: {"components": ["component.<name>"]}, listing each Taproot component to use. Use an empty list if Taproot has no component for this.
I need a date picker with a calendar popup for a booking form. Which Taproot component is that?

I can't tell you which Taproot component this is because I don't have Taproot's component catalog or any tools in this session to search the project for it. I also don't want to guess a name that may not exist.

To find it, search Taproot's docs or package exports for `date`, `calendar`, or `picker`. Design systems sometimes split this into a date input and a separate calendar or popover, so you may need to combine them.

If you share the component list or the path to Taproot's docs, I can identify the right component for your booking form. The empty list below means I couldn't confirm a match, not that Taproot doesn't have one.
